title: Engram host-adapter brief still says a focused launcher run never shows passing tests
outcome: docs/features/engram-host-adapter.md (~line 1634, the passing-evidence paragraph) says 'A focused launcher run never shows it, since its verdict does not say how many tests the wrapped command ran.' After the focused-credit change, a focused run shows passing tests when its own results.json backs the pass (passed > 0, failed == 0) and the summary's first verdict names that run. Reword it to the new rule and cross-link docs/test.md#which-stages-count-as-tests, per the feature-brief cross-link convention.
acceptance: Engram host-adapter brief still says a focused launcher run never shows passing tests is done
